svg.title: Fixed-period column solver: 165 outputs, 107 recovered the planted passage
svg.desc: The original source key inference was applied to three fixed key lengths on 55 pages. One known reading, fitted to each page length, was recovered in 107 of 165 settings and not recovered in 58. None of the 107 corresponding LP2 outputs crossed the separately declared English threshold.

g.text: 0 of those crossed the English line
58 did not recover this planted text
